verdict.rationale: Sentry documents an Alerts product and first-party Slack and PagerDuty notification integrations. Its pricing pages list alerts and notifications via email, so the routing destinations named in the story are covered. However, the evidence is mostly page titles with no detail on rule conditions or filtering. missing for 10: documented per-rule triggers for new issue, frequency spike and affected-user count; filtering by environment and severity; per-project routing detail; independent or hands-on corroboration.
